def analyze(p):
    g,o=p['input'],p['output']
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    filled=[];notf=[]
    for r in range(H):
        cs=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            cells=[(r,c) for c in range(a+1,b)]
            allbg=all(g[r][c]==bg for c in range(a+1,b))
            did=all(o[r][c]==3 for c in range(a+1,b))
            (filled if did else notf).append(('row',r,a,b,b-a-1,allbg))
    for c in range(W):
        rs=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=bg]
        for a,b in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
            cells=[(r,c) for r in range(a+1,b)]
            allbg=all(g[r][c]==bg for r in range(a+1,b))
            did=all(o[r][c]==3 for r in range(a+1,b))
            (filled if did else notf).append(('col',c,a,b,b-a-1,allbg))
    return filled,notf
